decision_description: Conflict identified between Tier 3 (docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/strategic_positioning.md) and Tier 2B (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json): strategic_positioning.md uses the label 'SR-04' to refer to the external tools and APIs key aspect (lines 15 and 47), whereas in the authoritative Tier 2B scope_requirements.json, SR-04 designates the ADRA and GenAI4EU Hub cohesion activities requirement, and the external tools and APIs requirement is identified as SR-02(c). Both requirements are substantively addressed in the MAESTRO concept; the conflict is a mislabelling in Tier 3 rather than a substantive scope gap or coverage failure. Resolution: Tier 2B scope_requirements.json governs the authoritative requirement identifiers per CLAUDE.md §3. The external tools and APIs requirement is SR-02(c) in Tier 2B; SR-04 is the ADRA and GenAI4EU Hub cohesion activities requirement. Tier 3 strategic_positioning.md must be corrected to align with Tier 2B canonical labelling in the next draft revision.
alternatives_considered: Treating the Tier 3 mislabelling as a blocking conflict requiring immediate correction of strategic_positioning.md before Phase 2 gate passage — rejected because the conflict is limited to reference labels; both the external tools and APIs requirement (SR-02(c)) and the ADRA cohesion requirement (SR-04) are substantively covered in the concept, and no downstream phase output or coverage assessment is materially dependent on the incorrect Tier 3 label.

Treating the mislabelling as an internal Tier 3 consistency issue falling outside the tier conflict classification — rejected because strategic_positioning.md is a Tier 3 document that uses a requirement identifier (SR-04 for external tools and APIs) that directly contradicts the Tier 2B canonical identifier for the same content. This cross-tier reference conflict constitutes a contradiction between tiers and requires a decision log entry under CLAUDE.md §12.3.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §3 authority hierarchy — Tier 2B (Priority 5) governs over Tier 3 (Priority 6); Tier 2B scope_requirements.json (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json) is the governing authority for canonical requirement identifiers and scope definitions
rationale: Per the authority hierarchy in CLAUDE.md §3, Tier 2B topic and call sources (Priority 5) rank above Tier 3 project instantiation (Priority 6). When a Tier 3 document reference label conflicts with a Tier 2B canonical identifier, Tier 2B governs without exception. The Tier 2B scope_requirements.json is unambiguous: SR-02 covers three mandatory key aspects of effective AI agent design including (c) integration of external tools and APIs to overcome large AI model limitations; SR-04 is exclusively the ADRA and GenAI4EU Hub cohesion activities requirement. The mislabelling in strategic_positioning.md does not affect substantive scope coverage — both the external tools and APIs requirement (SR-02(c) per Tier 2B) and the cohesion activities requirement (SR-04 per Tier 2B) are addressed in the concept and confirmed covered in concept_refinement_summary.json scope_coverage entries SR-02 and SR-04 respectively. Per CLAUDE.md §12.3, this resolved cross-tier conflict must be recorded in the decision log identifying the resolution method, the tier that prevailed, and the reasoning. The Tier 3 strategic_positioning.md document must be corrected in a subsequent draft to remove the erroneous SR-04 label for external tools and APIs and replace it with the Tier 2B canonical identifier SR-02(c).
